preconditions.description: The number of necklace parts n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a < 2**20 and 0 <= b < 2**20 for a, b in parts)
preconditions.description: Each pearl color a and b in the n parts is a non-negative integer less than 2^20.
There are exactly n lines of pearl pairs following the first line.

postconditions.description: The integer b is the maximum possible beauty achievable by forming a valid necklace cycle using all parts, where beauty is the minimum connection beauty in the cycle.
The permutation contains exactly 2n distinct integers from 1 to 2n, and for every part i (1-indexed), the indices 2i-1 and 2i appear adjacent to each other in the cycle.
The minimum beauty of any adjacent connection in the constructed cycle equals the reported value b.
